messages.content: Should I use "inzu" or "urugo" to compare two places? I want to say one is bigger than the other, but I have not said what kind of places they are.

Do you mean two physical buildings, or two homes or households as lived places? "Inzu ni nini" describes a building's size, while "urugo ruratuje" can describe a peaceful home. Which meaning do you intend?
I mean two physical houses in the same neighborhood, not households. The blue house is bigger than the white house.

Use "inzu": "Inzu y'ubururu ni nini kurusha iy'umweru." Here, "iy'umweru" stands for "inzu y'umweru." "Urugo" would shift the meaning toward a home or household rather than simply the physical building.

messages.content: Mu iduka navuze nti: "Umpa izi nkweto kureba?" Nashakaga ko umucuruzi yazimpa kugira ngo nzirebe neza. Kuki interuro yanjye itumvikana neza?
Vuga uti: "Mwampa izi nkweto nkazireba neza, nyabuneka?" Umpa ni itegeko ritaziguye, naho mwampa yumvikanisha icyifuzo mu kinyabupfura. Nkazireba kandi igaragaza icyo ushakira inkweto.
Nashakaga no kubaza igiciro cy'izi nkweto, ariko sinshaka kuvuga gusa nti: "Ni angahe?" Nabaza nte mu kinyabupfura?
Wabaza uti: "Mwambwira igiciro cy'izi nkweto, nyabuneka?" Gusubiramo izi nkweto bituma icyo ubaza gisobanuka neza.
Noneho nshaka kubanza kuzireba, hanyuma nkabaza igiciro. Nabivuga nte mu nteruro imwe?
Vuga uti: "Mwampa izi nkweto nkazireba neza, hanyuma mukambwira igiciro cy'izi nkweto, nyabuneka?" Iyi nteruro ikomeza gahunda yawe: kubanza kureba inkweto, nyuma ukabaza igiciro.

messages.content: Ndashaka kuvuga ngo, "Tugomba ku-save amazi kuko ari important." Nabikosora nte?
Vuga uti: "Tugomba kubungabunga amazi kuko ari ingenzi." I replaced ku-save with kubungabunga and important with ingenzi. The corrected sentence keeps your meaning entirely in natural Kinyarwanda.
None se iyi nteruro irakwiye: "Abana barabungabunga amazi kuishuri"?

Andika uti: "Abana barabungabunga amazi ku ishuri." Hindura kuishuri ibe ku ishuri. In this phrase, ku and ishuri are separate words even though the vowels meet in speech; the rest of your sentence was already correct.

messages.content: I want to write "I cook it with oil" in Kinyarwanda. Should I use "na mavuta" or "n'amavuta"?
What are you cooking? I need the missing noun before giving the full sentence. For the spelling alone, "n'amavuta" is the joined form with an apostrophe.
I am cooking beans. I mean, "I cook beans with oil." Please show me the complete sentence.
Wavuga uti: "Nteka ibishyimbo n'amavuta." Wandika "n'amavuta" ukoresheje apostrophe hagati ya n na amavuta; ntiwandika "na mavuta" muri iyi nteruro.

messages.content: Read this short passage: "Mutesi yabonye inzu nshya. Bukeye, Mutesi yarayisukuye." Please keep the exact form "yarayisukuye," show its written practice syllables, and tell me what "yi" refers to.

For written pronunciation practice, divide it as "ya-ra-yi-su-ku-ye"; the complete word remains "yarayisukuye." The form "yi" refers to "inzu." Thus, "Bukeye, Mutesi yarayisukuye" means "The next day, Mutesi cleaned it." The syllable grouping shows how to practice the word, while the reference of "yi" explains its grammar.

messages.content: Ejo nagiye gutembera na mubyara wanjye, tubona umwana babiri bakinaga umupira.

Interuro ikosoye ni: "Ejo nagiye gutembera na mubyara wanjye, tubona abana babiri bakinaga umupira." Because you saw two children, "umwana" changes to the plural "abana." "Bakinaga" already matches that plural. Byagenze bite nyuma?
Hanyuma abana babiri baricaye, kandi inshuti zabo zari zibategereje hafi.

Ni interuro nziza kandi ikomeza inkuru neza. "Inshuti" has the same written noun form in the singular and plural, so the surrounding words show the number. Here, "inshuti zabo zari" refers to several friends; for one friend, you would say "inshuti yabo yari."

messages.content: Ndashaka gukosora gahunda yanjye. Navuze nti: "Umwaka utaha ntabwo sinzajya ku ishuri n'imodoka, kuko ndashaka kugendana n'amaguru buri munsi."

Interuro ikosoye ni: "Umwaka utaha sinzajya ku ishuri n'imodoka, kuko ndashaka kujya n'amaguru buri munsi."

I removed "ntabwo" because "sinzajya" already makes the verb negative; using both creates an awkward double negation. I also changed "kugendana n'amaguru" to the natural expression "kujya n'amaguru." Your future plan and reason stay the same.
Noneho ndumva. Ariko se nshobora gukoresha "ntabwo" aho gukoresha "sinzajya"?

Yego. Ushobora guhitamo uburyo bumwe muri ubu:

"Umwaka utaha sinzajya ku ishuri n'imodoka."
"Umwaka utaha ntabwo nzajya ku ishuri n'imodoka."

Both mean "Next year, I will not go to school by car." Ntukavuge "ntabwo sinzajya" muri iyi nteruro, kuko byashyiramo uburyo bubiri bwo guhakana icyarimwe.

messages.content: Nshaka kwandikira umuyobozi nti: "Hi, ndi working kuri raporo, then nzayohereza." Mwankosorera ubu butumwa?
Kubera ko wandikira umuyobozi, imvugo yubashye irakwiye. Ariko then ntisobanura neza intambwe ibanza: urabanza kwandika raporo, kuyisuzuma, cyangwa gukora ikindi?
Ndabanza kuyisuzuma, hanyuma nzayoherereza umuyobozi uyu munsi. Ndashaka ubutumwa bugufi kandi bwubashye.

Wandika uti: Mwaramutse. Ubu ndimo ndasuzuma raporo. Nyuma yo kuyisuzuma, nzabagezaho raporo uyu munsi. Murakoze. Mwaramutse na Murakoze bituma ubutumwa bwubaha uwo wandikira, naho Nyuma yo kuyisuzuma igaragaza neza urukurikirane rw'ibikorwa.

messages.content: I told a friend, "Nari going to the bus station, imvura itangira kugwa." How can I say the whole event naturally?
Say: "Nari ngiye kuri gare, imvura itangira kugwa." Nari ngiye naturally expresses "I was heading," so the English word going is unnecessary.
How would I tell the same event politely to a driver I do not know?
You can say: "Mwiriwe. Nari ngiye kuri gare, imvura itangira kugwa." The respectful greeting changes the register, while the event itself remains unchanged.

messages.content: Uyu munsi hano hari ibicu kandi harakonje. Nabivuga nte mu kiganiro gisanzwe?
Vuga uti: "Uyu munsi hari ibicu kandi harakonje." Ibyo birumvikana kandi bifite injyana isanzwe. Uzakora iki nimugoroba?
Nashaka kugenda urugendo nimugoroba.
Byumvikana, ariko hano wavuga neza uti: "Nashaka gutembera nimugoroba." Ni bwo buryo busanzwe bwo kuvuga ko ushaka kujya gutembera.
Niba imvura iguye, nzaguma mu rugo nsome igitabo.
Ni interuro nziza. Mu kiganiro kigufi wavuga uti: "Niba imvura iguye, nzaguma mu rugo nsome igitabo. Niba itaguye, nzatembera." Ibyo bihuza neza ikirere na gahunda yawe.

messages.content: In a chat, what does "kuvuga ikintu mu yandi magambo" mean? Please give me a short example.

It means "to say something in different words," or to paraphrase. Urugero: "Yavuze ubutumwa mu yandi magambo kugira ngo busobanuke." This means that he or she restated the message to make it clear, rather than repeating the exact same words.

messages.content: How do I say, 'I feel tired today, so I will rest now and revise tomorrow's plan' in Kinyarwanda? Please explain one spelling choice.

Uyu munsi ndumva naniwe, ni yo mpamvu ngiye kuruhuka ubu, kandi ejo nzavugurura gahunda y'ejo.

'Ndumva naniwe' is a natural way to describe feeling tired. In 'y'ejo,' the apostrophe joins the linking form 'ya' to 'ejo,' giving the meaning 'tomorrow's.'

messages.content:
Soma uyu mwandiko: Ku wa Gatatu, Aline yageze kuri gare saa moya n'igice za mu gitondo. Yaguze itike y'imodoka ijya i Musanze. Imodoka yagombaga guhaguruka saa mbili za mu gitondo.

Aline yageze kuri gare ryari? Imodoka yajyaga he kandi yagombaga guhaguruka ryari? Igiciro cy'itike cyari angahe? Nanone, 'itike' ni iki?

Aline yageze kuri gare saa moya n'igice za mu gitondo. Imodoka yajyaga i Musanze kandi yagombaga guhaguruka saa mbili za mu gitondo. Igiciro cy'itike ntikivugwa mu mwandiko. Itike ni icyemezo kigaragaza ko umuntu yemerewe gukora urugendo.

messages.content: Ese iyi nteruro irakwiye: "Inama uzatangira saa tatu izabera ku biro by'umurenge"?

Hindura "uzatangira" uvuge "izatangira": "Inama izatangira saa tatu izabera ku biro by'umurenge." Inshinga "izatangira" yerekeza ku nama, naho "uzatangira" yakwerekeza ku muntu ubwirwa. Igice "izabera ku biro by'umurenge" cyari gisanzwe gikwiriye.

messages.content: Ndashaka gutegura umukino w'umupira w'amaguru ku wa Gatandatu saa kumi. How can I invite my friends naturally?
Wavuga uti: "Nshuti zanjye, tuzakina umupira w'amaguru ku wa Gatandatu saa kumi. Muzaze dukine!" Ibi birumvikana kandi bifite injyana isanzwe mu butumwa bugufi.
Actually, the field is busy then. I want to move the same game to Sunday at saa tatu, not plan a different activity.
Wahindura ubutumwa uti: "Nshuti zanjye, umukino wacu w'umupira w'amaguru wimuriwe ku Cyumweru saa tatu. Muzaze dukine!" "Umukino wacu" makes it clear that this is the same game.
Two friends cannot come that early. Let's keep Sunday but change it to saa kumi. How should I revise it?
Vuga uti: "Nshuti zanjye, tuzakina umupira w'amaguru ku Cyumweru saa kumi, si saa tatu. Muzaze dukine!" Umunsi n'igikorwa ntibihindutse; isaha ni yo yahindutse.
Good. I also want to ask everyone to bring water for that game. Can you give me the final message?
Dore ubutumwa bwa nyuma: "Nshuti zanjye, tuzakina umupira w'amaguru ku Cyumweru saa kumi. Buri wese azane amazi yo kunywa. Muzaze dukine!"

messages.content: Ndashaka kwitoza guha umunyeshuri inzira iva ku irembo ijya ku isomero. Agomba kunyura ku biro by'ubuyobozi, agahindukira ibumoso, maze akagera ku isomero.
Ni byiza. Tangira na "banza," ukoreshe "hanyuma" ku ntambwe ikurikiraho, urangize na "maze." Gerageza gutanga ayo mabwiriza.
Banza unyure ibiro by'ubuyobozi, nyuma uhindukire ibumoso, maze ugere ku isomero.
Birumvikana. Kosora "unyure ibiro" uvuge "unyure ku biro." Kandi "hanyuma" irahuza izi ntambwe neza: "Banza unyure ku biro by'ubuyobozi, hanyuma uhindukire ibumoso, maze ugere ku isomero."
Banza unyure ku biro by'ubuyobozi, hanyuma uhindukire ibumoso, maze ugere ku isomero.
Ni byo. "Banza," "hanyuma" na "maze" bituma inzira ikurikirana neza kandi ikorohera uyumva.

messages.content: What is the natural English translation of "Buri gitondo mbyuka saa kumi n'ebyiri, ariko mpaguruka nyuma y'iminota itanu"? I am practicing kubyuka and guhaguruka.
"Every morning I wake up at six, but I get up five minutes later." Here mbyuka means "I wake up," while mpaguruka means "I get up" or rise from where I was lying or sitting.
How about "Uyu munsi nabyutse kare, ariko nahagurutse nyuma"?
It means: "Today I woke up early, but I got up later." Nabyutse describes becoming awake; nahagurutse describes actually getting up, so the same distinction is preserved.

messages.content: Translate: "Did she move our appointment, or did you move it?"
"Ese ni we wimuye gahunda yacu, cyangwa ni wowe wayimuye?" Ni we and ni wowe clearly contrast "she" with "you." The object marker -yi- in wayimuye refers back to gahunda.
I mean one woman, and I am asking one person informally. How do I add, "Please tell me because I did not hear her clearly"?

Say: "Ese ni we wimuye gahunda yacu, cyangwa ni wowe wayimuye? Mbwira, ndakwinginze, kuko sinamwumvise neza." The context keeps we and -mu- referring to the same woman; Kinyarwanda does not mark her gender in those forms.

messages.content: Please translate "Inama nshya zizatangira ejo saa tatu" and clarify why it uses zizatangira rather than izatangira.

It means: "The new meetings will start tomorrow at nine o'clock." Inama nshya zizatangira ejo saa tatu. Here, nshya and zi- show that inama is plural. For one meeting, you would say inama nshya izatangira.

messages.content: Translate this into English: "Nagiye ku biro by'umurenge gusaba icyemezo, ariko abakozi bambwiye ko ngomba kugaruka ejo kuko kitari cyiteguye."

"I went to the sector office to request a certificate, but the staff told me that I must return tomorrow because it was not ready." In the Kinyarwanda sentence, "ki-" in "kitari" refers to "icyemezo," not the office or the staff. Icyemezo ni cyo kitari cyiteguye.

messages.content: I said to a clerk, "Mpa uyu fomu, ndashaka kuyuzuza." How can I make it formal?

Mu mvugo y'icyubahiro, vuga uti: "Mwampa iyi fomu, ndashaka kuyuzuza?" Hindura mpa ibe mwampa to make the request polite. Also use iyi, not uyu, because fomu takes the demonstrative iyi. The rest was correct.

messages.content: We changed our practice plan. Nanditse nti: "Ikipe wacu izakora imyitozo ku wa Gatandatu, atari ku Cyumweru." Is the possessive correct?

Interuro ikosowe ni: "Ikipe yacu izakora imyitozo ku wa Gatandatu, atari ku Cyumweru." Change wacu to yacu because ikipe takes the possessive form yacu. Everything else in your revised plan stays unchanged.

messages.content: Why does "Ndimo kohereza ubutumwa kuri telefone buri munsi" sound unnatural if I mean "I send messages by phone every day"?

A natural version is: "Nohereza ubutumwa kuri telefone buri munsi." The words "ndimo kohereza" emphasize an action happening right now, while "buri munsi" describes a repeated habit, so the simpler verb form fits your meaning better.

messages.content: Nashatse kuvuga ko nahamagaye mushiki wanjye ejo, ariko nshyiramo ijambo ry'Icyongereza risobanura we. Nabivuga nte mu Kinyarwanda gusa, kandi uhamagarwa agaragarira he mu nshinga?

Vuga uti: Namuhamagaye ejo. Agace mu kari muri namuhamagaye gasimbura umuntu umwe uhamagarwa, yaba umukobwa cyangwa umuhungu. Iyo uvuga bashiki bawe benshi, wavuga uti: Nabahamagaye ejo; muri uwo mwanya ba ibasimbura. Ushobora no kuvuga izina aho kurisimbuza: Nahamagaye mushiki wanjye ejo.

messages.content: Can you use the Kinyarwanda word for artist in two contexts, one involving visual art and one involving music?

Yes. Umuhanzi yashushanyije ishusho y'umusozi means "The artist drew a picture of a mountain." Umuhanzi yaririmbye indirimbo nshya means "The artist sang a new song." Context tells us whether umuhanzi is a visual artist or a musical performer.
What is the plural, and does only the noun change?

The plural is abahanzi, and the verb changes too: Abahanzi bashushanyije ishusho y'umusozi. Abahanzi baririmbye indirimbo nshya. The plural subject abahanzi takes plural agreement in bashushanyije and baririmbye.
So can abahanzi mean painters in one sentence and singers in another without changing its plural form?

Exactly. Abahanzi keeps the same plural form in both contexts: Abahanzi berekanye amashusho yabo refers to visual artists, while Abahanzi baririmbye indirimbo refers to singers. The surrounding action supplies the more specific meaning.

messages.content: I wrote, Nagiye ku biro gusaba by'umurenge icyemezo. I mean that I went to the sector office to request a certificate. How should I correct it?
Say: Nagiye ku biro by'umurenge gusaba icyemezo. Keep by'umurenge directly after ibiro because it identifies which office. Then gusaba icyemezo states your purpose.
For the follow-up, I wrote, Ejo hashize nagiye gusaba ku biro by'umurenge icyemezo. Is that order right?
A clearer order is: Ejo hashize nagiye ku biro by'umurenge gusaba icyemezo. Ejo hashize gives the time, ku biro by'umurenge gives the destination, and gusaba icyemezo gives the purpose.

messages.content: I want to say, "Next year I will set two goals." Is "Umwaka utaha nzagena intego bibiri" correct?

Almost. Say: "Umwaka utaha nzagena intego ebyiri." Change bibiri to ebyiri so the number agrees with intego. The noun intego has the same visible form in the singular and plural, but ebyiri clearly marks it as plural here.
I revised the plan to "Nzandika intego ebyiri gishya kandi nzazikurikirana buri kwezi." Is the adjective correct?

Use: "Nzandika intego ebyiri nshya kandi nzazikurikirana buri kwezi." Change gishya to nshya because the adjective describes the plural noun intego. The rest correctly means that you will write the goals down and track them every month.

messages.content: Ndashaka gusaba nyogokuru ikaramu. Navuga nti: Mpa ikaramu, nyogokuru?
Wabivuga mu kinyabupfura uti: Nyogokuru, wampa ikaramu, ndakwinginze? Mpa ni itegeko ritaziguye; wampa ihindura icyifuzo kikaba ikibazo cyoroheje.
Murakoze. Nshaka no gusaba igitabo. Navuga nti: None se, mpa icyo gitabo?
Komeza ukoreshe wampa: None se, wampa icyo gitabo, ndakwinginze? Wahinduye mpa ukayigira wampa; icyo gitabo gisigaye uko cyari kiri kuko cyari gikwiye.

messages.content: Mwaramutse, mwarimu. Ndashaka kukubwira impamvu nahisemo kwiga ubudozi.

Interuro ikosoye ni: "Mwaramutse, mwarimu. Ndashaka kubabwira impamvu nahisemo kwiga ubudozi." Kubera ko uvugisha mwarimu mu buryo bwiyubashye, kukubwira ihinduka kubabwira. Ibindi byose wari wabivuze neza.

messages.content: Ndagereranya umuganda na igitaramo. Ntekereza ko umuganda ariwiza.

Igitekerezo cyawe kirumvikana. Kosora ibintu bibiri: "Ndagereranya umuganda n'igitaramo. Ntekereza ko umuganda ari mwiza." Andika "n'igitaramo," si "na igitaramo," kandi "ari mwiza" ni amagambo abiri.
None se, navuga nte ko igitaramo ari cyiza ku rubyiruko kurusha umuganda?
Wavuga uti: "Igitaramo ni cyiza ku rubyiruko kurusha umuganda." Aha, "kurusha" ni ryo jambo rigaragaza ko ugereranya ibyo bikorwa bibiri.
